sources.title: Assignment 1: Build Your Own LLaMa
sources.snippet: The assignment consists of two main parts: Part 1: Core Implementation. In this part, you will complete the missing components of the Llama2 model architecture. Specifically, implement: Attention mechanisms Feed-forward networks Layer normalization (LayerNorm) Positional encodings (RoPE) Part 2: Applications.
